 Khaleel Unnabi

 Appearance:
Shri Abhinav Dhanodkar - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Hemant Sharma - Govt. Advocate for the respondent/S
 Shri Makbool Ahmad Mansoori - Advocate for the complaina
 Order
They are heard and perused the case diary.

2] This is the applicant's third bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.0991/2024 registered at Police Station - Chandan Nagar, Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468,
471 & 201 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 7.11.2024.
3] The allegation against the applicant is of committing fraud to the tune of Rs.9,95,00,000/-.
4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the matter relates to sale of land, in which the parties have also come to a compromise.
The applicant is lodged in jail since 7.11.2024 and the final conclusion of trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Thus, it is prayed that the application be allowed.
5] Shri M.A. Mansoori, learned counsel for the complainant Simmi Bahal submits that the complainant has no objection if this application is allowed.

7] On due consideration of submissions and on perusal of the case-diary and taking note of the fact that complainant has no objection if the application is allowed and the matter also appears to be personal in nature, this Court is inclined to allow the present application.
8] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

9] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of .
C.c. as per rules.
